versions.proposal:
Maple, you need a mobile-first online booking system for your three-location clinic in Toronto with automated reminders to bring down your 14% no-show rate. Your setup requires multi-location scheduling, patient deposits, and strict Canadian data residency.

I built a booking and reminders system for a two-location dental practice that featured online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, and Stripe deposits. That system successfully reduced no-shows from 11% to 4% in three months.

I am based in Canada and work with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, which matches your exact technical requirements. For the admin calendar with drag-to-reschedule functionality, I will implement robust React-based calendar libraries to give your front-desk staff a smooth experience.

First, we will map out the multi-location database schema and booking logic on Canadian-hosted infrastructure. Second, we will build the mobile-first booking interface, Stripe deposit flow, and the admin calendar. Third, we will connect the automated SMS and email reminders.

Which appointment scheduling libraries do you prefer for the admin calendar view?

screeningAnswers.question: Which stack would you use and why?
screeningAnswers.answer: I would use Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL hosted on AWS in Canada to meet your data residency needs and deliver a fast mobile-first experience.

screeningAnswers.question: How would you handle double-bookings when two patients pick the same slot?
screeningAnswers.answer: I would handle this using database-level locking and transactional constraints in PostgreSQL so that the first patient to complete the checkout secures the slot instantly.

state.job:
Online booking + reminders for a 3-location physiotherapy clinic (Toronto)

We run three physio clinics and still take most bookings by phone. We want patients to book, reschedule and cancel online, and get SMS/email reminders so our no-show rate drops (it is around 14% right now).

Must have:
- Patient-facing booking page (mobile first) showing real availability per therapist and location
- Admin calendar for front-desk staff, with drag to reschedule
- SMS + email reminders 24h and 2h before, with a confirm/cancel link
- Stripe deposit for new patients only
- Data stored in Canada (PHIPA matters to us)

Nice to have: waitlist that auto-offers cancelled slots, simple reporting on no-shows.

Budget: $6,000-8,000 fixed, phased. We'd like a first usable version in 5-6 weeks.

To make sure you read this, start your proposal with the word "Maple".
Please answer:
1. Which stack would you use and why?
2. How would you handle double-bookings when two patients pick the same slot?
state.profile:
Demo profile — replace with your own.

Full-stack & AI developer, 7 years. Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Python.
- Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice: online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, Stripe deposits. No-shows fell from 11% to 4% in 3 months.
- Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets), incl. lead scoring with an LLM.
- Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions. Answer accuracy went from 71% to 89% after retrieval tuning.
- React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
- AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3) and Vercel; CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Based in Canada (Eastern time).
